# temps_error_ownership_rules (Resource)

Who owns a project's new errors: the first rule whose pattern matches an error's file or message assigns it. Replaces all of the project's rules; destroying the resource removes them.

Import with `<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `error_tracking:read`, `error_tracking:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_error_ownership_rules" "web" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  rules = jsonencode([
    { pattern = "src/billing/**", owner_user_id = 1 },
    { pattern = "src/auth/**", owner_user_id = 2 },
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `rules` (String) Rules in order: `jsonencode([{ pattern = "src/billing/**", owner_user_id = 4 }])`. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>
terraform import temps_error_ownership_rules.web 8
```
